profile_text.body:
CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, with the ticker CCC and SEC CIK 0001818201. Its listed website is calgoncarbon.com.

The text drawn from that site describes Calgon Carbon as an activated carbon provider addressing air and water purification needs. It describes FILTRASORB, a reagglomerated coal-based activated carbon, as made in the United States and as proven by over 40 years of use in applications including TOC reduction and contaminant removal from drinking water, wastewater treatment, and purification in process water, food, pharmaceutical, and industrial settings. The site material does not describe AI products or services.

The held facts list no products and no MCP servers for the company, and no individual lawsuits. Litigation exposure is recorded for Illinois with a count of 375.
